claims.evidence: Protocol: human fibroblasts; UniProt human database. PRIDE organism field says Mus musculus and is contradicted by the protocol (human DB search) and the paper.
Paper: cultured human skin fibroblasts; protocol: control and m.9205delTA MT-ATP6 fibroblasts. Material type cell (primary cells immortalized with E7 and hTERT per paper), not a named cell line.

Experiment names in the deposited mqpar.xml map each RAW file to one experiment; replicate number is the trailing -1..-5; protocol mentions five replicates (3 of 5 filter). Whether these are independent cultures is not stated.

claims.value: wild type for JH-* rows; m.9205delTA MT-ATP6 for dTA* rows
claims.evidence: Decoded from mqpar.xml experiment prefixes (JH = control, dTA = m.9205delTA) with protocol 'control and m.9205delTA MT-ATP6 fibroblasts'. JH-prefix as control is an inference from the protocol listing control first and the paper using wild-type control fibroblasts; no explicit key deposited.

claims.value: none for *-37-* / *37-* rows; heat shock, 45 degrees Celsius for 4 hours for *-45-* / *45-* rows
claims.evidence: PRIDE sampleProcessingProtocol/dataProcessingProtocol: cultured at 37C or following a 4 hour heat shock at 45C; temperature decoded from experiment suffix 37/45 in mqpar.xml. 'none' means growth at 37C without heat shock.

claims.value: normal for JH rows (10 rows); not available for dTA rows (10 rows)
claims.evidence: Control fibroblasts labelled normal; the mutant fibroblasts' clinical diagnosis is not given in the PRIDE record, so not available (genotype is captured in characteristics[genotype]).
Donor details not stated in PRIDE text or the methods read.
Protocol: quadrupole Orbitrap QExactivePlus; PRIDE field says Q Exactive; the protocol is preferred. Accession verified in OLS.
Protocol: trypsin without proline restriction option; mqpar.xml enzymes: Trypsin/P, 2 missed cleavages.
mqpar.xml mainSearchTol 4.5 and FTMS MatchTolerance 20 ppm (first search 20 ppm in protocol).

claims.value: Carbamidomethyl C fixed (UNIMOD:4); Oxidation M variable (UNIMOD:35); Acetyl Protein N-term variable (UNIMOD:1)
claims.evidence: mqpar.xml fixedModifications Carbamidomethyl (C); protocol and search-params: oxidation and protein N-acetylation variable.
Protocol: label-free quantification; one RAW per sample, no fractionation described.
All 20 deposited RAW files (PRIDE file list) claimed once; numbers P9325, P9331, P9337 absent from the deposit and not claimed.

Central directory read by HTTP range: txt/{allPeptides,evidence,modificationSpecificPeptides,msms,msmsScans,msScans,mzRange,peptides,proteinGroups,parameters,summary}.txt, Oxidation (M)Sites.txt, tables.pdf plus empty tables; it contains no raw files, so no run names come from it. All run names come from the PRIDE file list and mqpar.xml.

limitations: Group assignment (JH = control, dTA = m.9205delTA, 37/45 = temperature) is decoded from mqpar.xml experiment names, not from a deposited sample key.
Donor age, sex, individual, and the diagnosis of the mutant fibroblasts are not available; disease is 'normal' for control rows and 'not available' for mutant rows.
Cells are immortalized (E7/hTERT) primary skin fibroblasts, not a Cellosaurus cell line; the cell-lines template was therefore not declared.
Treatment 'heat shock, 45 degrees Celsius for 4 hours' is a free-text term (not an NCIT/EFO match) and gives a parse_sdrf warning.
Replicates 1-5 are numbered from experiment names; independence of biological replicates not stated.
PRIDE structured organism (Mus musculus) and instrument (Q Exactive) were overridden by the protocol text.
Raw files not inspected by header; instrument taken from protocol.
